title: Night Prayer of Thanksgiving | His Mercies Are New, Rest in His Faithfulness
description:
Thank God for today’s mercies, entrust its difficulties to him, and settle into KJV Scripture for the night.

0:39 Prayer: naming the day’s mercies

5:20 Mercy within a difficult day

8:30 Thanksgiving across the ordinary hours

12:22 Remembering without keeping score

18:41 Psalm 63:6
19:20 Psalm 63:7

22:03 Psalm 16:8
23:50 The warmth of divine love
